## Change and linked issue

Describe the resulting behavior and link the issue. Use `Closes #N` only when
its acceptance work is complete; otherwise link the open follow-up.

## Verification and tenant checks

Record relevant automated results and actual tenant test evidence. Identify
outstanding manual checks explicitly.

## Completion checklist

- [ ] Current design and relevant setup documentation agree with this change.
- [ ] Implementation plan records completion state, remaining work, and next ticket.
- [ ] Backlog alignment agrees with the issue scope and dependencies.
- [ ] After merge: verify PR/issue status and reconcile the plan before the next ticket.
